# Logistics 0.1.2 alpha 5

- Expand Books and Comics desktop/mobile reading parity, library navigation, speech and typography controls.
- Consolidate rclone workflows with transfer review, retry handling, remote browsing and direct readers.
- Improve mobile storage navigation, privacy controls, reader gestures, fullscreen behavior and control icons.
- Include updated shared native UI components and Android/iOS validation coverage.

The iOS TestFlight application version is 0.1.6. GitHub publication requires desktop platform checks, native mobile builds and mobile runtime validation to pass.

Includes updated mobile regression fixtures, final collection-storage wording, and the portable runtime contract for the expanded privacy test coverage. Supersedes the unpublished alpha 1 through 4 candidates.

Fixes Android privacy-listener handling during configuration changes and synchronizes native UI checks with reader reloads and Home scrolling.

Uses portable Windows review fixtures and verified Objective-C getter handling in native iOS UI checks.
